items.html: So too, likewise, are “Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh” in the HGT of the throat, with Tifferet being the “Asher” between them. And likewise “Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh” in the NHY, with the “Asher” being the Yesod between them. However, in the verse only the three supernal ones mentioned are stated, since all these are included within them, as mentioned, because they rise from below to above in the secret of MAN and are included in the two supernal names of Ehyeh.
